subject: fix(rdp): reapply performance flags and input finalizer on all reconnect paths
body:
fix(rdp): reapply performance flags and input finalizer on all reconnect paths

Стадия A5. Унифицирует поведение reconnect:
- SetPerformanceFlags / StartReconnectInputFinalizer стали protected.
- Performance flags переустанавливаются при ActiveX auto-reconnect
  (OnAutoReconnecting), mRemoteNG tmrReconnect (перед Connect) и
  RDP8 resize-reconnect — иначе сервер возвращал композицию/тени.
- Reconnect-финализатор (release-capture) подключён к RDP8 resize.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: Reapplying performance flags on mstscax auto-reconnect is a plausible real fix, but patch depends on fork-only view-only/input-finalizer infrastructure we lack. Note idea, not code.

votes.concern: The donor’s passive-only APIs do not exist here, while its unverified flag rewrite could regress our independently refactored reconnect paths.
votes.reason: Exact commit cannot land: RdpProtocol6 was deleted, passive helpers are absent, RdpProtocol8 is refactored, and no tests or reproducible evidence are provided.

votes.concern: Passive-RDP helpers/HANDOFF may not exist here; pFlags mid-ActiveX reconnect unproven.
votes.reason: Reapplying pFlags on reconnect is useful, but diff is fork-specific and needs local path checks.

dissent: codex: REJECT - Exact commit cannot land: RdpProtocol6 was deleted, passive helpers are absent, RdpProtocol8 is refactored, and no tests or reproducible evidence are provided.
grok: NEEDS_HUMAN - Reapplying pFlags on reconnect is useful, but diff is fork-specific and needs local path checks.
